# Claude models compared: cost vs quality at every effort level

> What each Claude model (Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku) costs at every effort level, and which gives the best quality for the price. Open data, CC BY 4.0.

Best value overall: Haiku 5.5 at high effort, 3.5× cheaper than the price trend for its quality (expected score 57.3 % on the benchmark panel, cost 2.2× the cheapest couple). Best pick by task tier: grunt work → Haiku 5.5 at low effort; everyday tasks → Haiku 5.5 at high effort; advanced reasoning → Opus 5.5 at xHigh effort; cutting-edge thinking → Opus 5.5 at max effort. Highest measured quality: Opus 5.5 at max effort (expected score 74.7 %, cost 179× the cheapest couple).

Costs are multiples of the cheapest couple's; quality is the expected score on the benchmark panel. Both are fused from measurements taken on the same task by a latent-quality model that estimates each benchmark's own scale (method: docs/METHODOLOGY.md in the source repository), from 370 sources · 1063 benchmarks · 6512 measurements. Updated 2026-10-15. Figures are indicative, derived from public third-party measurements; not affiliated with Anthropic.

## Report

- [Claude models compared: cost vs quality at every effort level](https://claude-models.agensse.com/): quality vs cost per model and effort level, Pareto frontier, best pick per task tier, normalized cost matrix, method and sources.
- [Fable vs Opus vs Sonnet vs Haiku: Claude models head-to-head](https://claude-models.agensse.com/claude-models-head-to-head.html): every pair of Claude models compared effort by effort, and the cheapest effort of each that matches the other.

## Head-to-head

- Fable 5.1 vs Opus 5.5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Fable 5.1 costs 1.4× to 3.0× what Opus 5.5 costs and scores 1.3 to 4.7 points lower on the benchmark panel. To match Fable 5.1 at max (70.1 %, cost 252×), the cheapest Opus 5.5 setting is medium (69.8 %, cost 32×): 8.0× cheaper per task. No Fable 5.1 setting reaches Opus 5.5 at max (74.7 %): Fable 5.1's best is max at 70.1 %.
- Fable 5.1 vs Sonnet 5.5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Fable 5.1 costs 2.2× to 6.9× what Sonnet 5.5 costs and scores between 3.2 points lower and 6.8 points higher on the benchmark panel. To match Fable 5.1 at max (70.1 %, cost 252×), the cheapest Sonnet 5.5 setting is xHigh (70.9 %, cost 32×): 7.8× cheaper per task. No Fable 5.1 setting reaches Sonnet 5.5 at max (73.3 %): Fable 5.1's best is max at 70.1 %.
- Fable 5.1 vs Haiku 5.5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Fable 5.1 costs 24× to 68× what Haiku 5.5 costs and scores 6.8 to 14.0 points higher on the benchmark panel. No Haiku 5.5 setting reaches Fable 5.1 at max (70.1 %): Haiku 5.5's best is max at 63.3 %. To match Haiku 5.5 at max (63.3 %, cost 11×), the cheapest Fable 5.1 setting is low (62.5 %, cost 68×): 6.4× dearer per task.
- Opus 5.5 vs Sonnet 5.5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Opus 5.5 costs 1.5× to 2.7× what Sonnet 5.5 costs and scores 1.5 to 10.3 points higher on the benchmark panel. No Sonnet 5.5 setting reaches Opus 5.5 at max (74.7 %): Sonnet 5.5's best is max at 73.3 %. To match Sonnet 5.5 at max (73.3 %, cost 116×), the cheapest Opus 5.5 setting is xHigh (73.6 %, cost 68×): 1.7× cheaper per task.
- Opus 5.5 vs Haiku 5.5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Opus 5.5 costs 15× to 23× what Haiku 5.5 costs and scores 11.5 to 16.4 points higher on the benchmark panel. No Haiku 5.5 setting reaches Opus 5.5 at max (74.7 %): Haiku 5.5's best is max at 63.3 %. To match Haiku 5.5 at max (63.3 %, cost 11×), the cheapest Opus 5.5 setting is low (63.8 %, cost 23×): 2.2× dearer per task.
- Sonnet 5.5 vs Haiku 5.5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Sonnet 5.5 costs 7.0× to 11× what Haiku 5.5 costs and scores 6.1 to 10.0 points higher on the benchmark panel. No Haiku 5.5 setting reaches Sonnet 5.5 at max (73.3 %): Haiku 5.5's best is max at 63.3 %. To match Haiku 5.5 at max (63.3 %, cost 11×), the cheapest Sonnet 5.5 setting is high (66.0 %, cost 17×): 1.6× dearer per task.
- Fable 5.1 vs Fable 5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Fable 5.1 costs 0.8× to 1.1× what Fable 5 costs and scores 1.3 to 3.4 points higher on the benchmark panel. No Fable 5 setting reaches Fable 5.1 at max (70.1 %): Fable 5's best is max at 67.8 %. To match Fable 5 at max (67.8 %, cost 239×), the cheapest Fable 5.1 setting is xHigh (69.2 %, cost 169×): 1.4× cheaper per task.
- Opus 5.5 vs Opus 5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Opus 5.5 costs 0.5× to 1.3× what Opus 5 costs and scores 3.7 to 6.4 points higher on the benchmark panel. No Opus 5 setting reaches Opus 5.5 at max (74.7 %): Opus 5's best is max at 68.3 %. To match Opus 5 at max (68.3 %, cost 135×), the cheapest Opus 5.5 setting is medium (69.8 %, cost 32×): 4.3× cheaper per task.
- Sonnet 5.5 vs Sonnet 5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Sonnet 5.5 costs 0.5× to 1.1× what Sonnet 5 costs and scores 10.1 to 15.2 points higher on the benchmark panel. No Sonnet 5 setting reaches Sonnet 5.5 at max (73.3 %): Sonnet 5's best is max at 58.0 %. To match Sonnet 5 at max (58.0 %, cost 103×), the cheapest Sonnet 5.5 setting is medium (59.5 %, cost 12×): 8.8× cheaper per task. Sonnet 5's cost is size-sensitive: a verbose model, its cost swings widely between short and long agentic tasks, hence its wide interval.
